pre_animation: variable.helmet_layer_visible = !query.has_head_gear;
variable.leg_layer_visible = 1.0;
variable.boot_layer_visible = 1.0;
variable.chest_layer_visible = 1.0;
variable.attack_body_rot_y = Math.sin(360*Math.sqrt(variable.attack_time)) * 5.0;
variable.tcos0 = (math.cos(query.modified_distance_moved * 38.17) * query.modified_move_speed / variable.gliding_speed_value) * 57.3;
variable.first_person_rotation_factor = math.sin((1 - variable.attack_time) * 180.0);

variable.hand_bob = query.life_time < 0.01 ? 0.0 : variable.hand_bob + ((query.is_on_ground && query.is_alive ? math.clamp(math.sqrt(math.pow(query.position_delta(0), 2.0) + math.pow(query.position_delta(2), 2.0)), 0.0, 0.1) : 0.0) - variable.hand_bob) * 0.02;
variable.map_angle = math.clamp(1 - variable.player_x_rotation / 45.1, 0.0, 1.0);
variable.item_use_normalized = query.main_hand_item_use_duration / query.main_hand_item_max_duration;
variable.riding_y_offset = query.is_riding_any_entity_of_type('minecraft:minecart', 'minecraft:boat', 'minecraft:chest_boat', 'minecraft:strider') ? -3.0 : 0.0;

temp.sa_target = (query.is_sneaking && !query.is_sleeping) ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_sneak_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_sneak_t ? math.min(variable.sa_sneak_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.16, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_sneak_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.16, 0.0); variable.sa_sneak = variable.sa_sneak_t * variable.sa_sneak_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_sneak_t);

temp.sa_target = (query.is_riding) ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_ride_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_ride_t ? math.min(variable.sa_ride_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.25, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_ride_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.25, 0.0); variable.sa_ride = variable.sa_ride_t * variable.sa_ride_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_ride_t);

temp.sa_target = (variable.is_holding_right ?? 0.0) ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_hold_r_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_hold_r_t ? math.min(variable.sa_hold_r_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_hold_r_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 0.0); variable.sa_hold_r = variable.sa_hold_r_t * variable.sa_hold_r_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_hold_r_t);

temp.sa_target = (variable.is_holding_left ?? 0.0) ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_hold_l_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_hold_l_t ? math.min(variable.sa_hold_l_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_hold_l_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 0.0); variable.sa_hold_l = variable.sa_hold_l_t * variable.sa_hold_l_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_hold_l_t);

temp.sa_target = (variable.is_brandishing_spear ?? 0.0) ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_trident_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_trident_t ? math.min(variable.sa_trident_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_trident_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 0.0); variable.sa_trident = variable.sa_trident_t * variable.sa_trident_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_trident_t);

temp.sa_target = (query.is_charging) ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_charge_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_charge_t ? math.min(variable.sa_charge_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_charge_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 0.0); variable.sa_charge = variable.sa_charge_t * variable.sa_charge_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_charge_t);

temp.sa_target = (variable.is_holding_spyglass ?? 0.0) ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_spyglass_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_spyglass_t ? math.min(variable.sa_spyglass_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_spyglass_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 0.0); variable.sa_spyglass = variable.sa_spyglass_t * variable.sa_spyglass_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_spyglass_t);

temp.sa_target = (variable.is_tooting_goat_horn ?? 0.0) ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_horn_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_horn_t ? math.min(variable.sa_horn_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_horn_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 0.0); variable.sa_horn = variable.sa_horn_t * variable.sa_horn_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_horn_t);

temp.sa_target = (variable.is_using_brush ?? 0.0) ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_brush_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_brush_t ? math.min(variable.sa_brush_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_brush_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.14, 0.0); variable.sa_brush = variable.sa_brush_t * variable.sa_brush_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_brush_t);

temp.sa_target = (query.get_equipped_item_name == 'bow' && ((variable.item_use_normalized ?? 0.0) > 0.0 && (variable.item_use_normalized ?? 0.0) < 1.0)) ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_bow_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_bow_t ? math.min(variable.sa_bow_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.12, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_bow_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.12, 0.0); variable.sa_bow = variable.sa_bow_t * variable.sa_bow_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_bow_t);

temp.sa_target = (query.blocking && query.get_equipped_item_name('off_hand') != 'shield' && query.get_equipped_item_name == 'shield') ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_shield_main_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_shield_main_t ? math.min(variable.sa_shield_main_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.1, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_shield_main_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.1, 0.0); variable.sa_shield_main = variable.sa_shield_main_t * variable.sa_shield_main_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_shield_main_t);

temp.sa_target = (query.blocking && query.get_equipped_item_name('off_hand') == 'shield') ? 1.0 : 0.0; variable.sa_shield_off_t = temp.sa_target > variable.sa_shield_off_t ? math.min(variable.sa_shield_off_t + math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.1, 1.0) : math.max(variable.sa_shield_off_t - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.1, 0.0); variable.sa_shield_off = variable.sa_shield_off_t * variable.sa_shield_off_t * (3.0 - 2.0 * variable.sa_shield_off_t);

variable.sa_arm_ok = (variable.player_arm_height ?? -1.0) >= 0.0; temp.sa_h = math.clamp(variable.player_arm_height ?? 1.0, 0.0, 1.0); variable.sa_arm = temp.sa_h >= variable.sa_arm ? temp.sa_h : math.max(temp.sa_h, variable.sa_arm - math.clamp(query.delta_time, 0.0, 0.25) / 0.08);
